meaning: First and last regular-season game dates. MLB: the Stats API season record's regular-season start and end dates. NBA, NFL and NHL: the first and last US Eastern ESPN scoreboard days listing a completed regular-season (season type 2) game, searched from ESPN's season-type window; the last day extends past the window while completed regular-season games appear within 21 days. A season in progress on the observation date has no last date.
